limitations: Current-survivor proxy universe; not a point-in-time ETF universe.
Yahoo auto-adjusted prices are a total-return proxy, not issuer NAV authority.
Macro and event snapshots are prospective context only; holdings, futures-curve, FX and tax inputs are absent.

methodology.curve: month-end historical observations in the same 10-point opportunity-score band
methodology.downside_risk: positioning-unwind watch requires prior 58-session gain >=15%, 5-session loss >=6%, relative loss versus SPY >=4%, and 21-session drawdown >=9%; only a material negative event upgrades it to downside bias
methodology.final_score: price score plus bounded fresh catalysts, decaying persistent sentiment, historical analogs, risk, and state-transition inputs; repeated coverage cannot multiply one theme
methodology.opportunity: 75% cross-sectional 21/63/126-session total-return momentum rank + 25% positive-trend confirmation
methodology.risk: equal-weight cross-sectional 63-session volatility and 126-session drawdown ranks

DEFENSE_ORDERS.rationale: Defense demand/procurement and financing state changes: automaker drone talks, Patriot hold-up, India-NZ and US-Qatar cooperation, Parker deal, Tomer bond, defense bank, Red Sea attack.

ECONOMIC_GROWTH.rationale: Verified macro state changes: Argentina technical recession, US hiring vs inflation, recession-risk warnings, Saudi budget deficit, Finland unemployment, NZ growth outlook, Mauritius debt.

ENERGY_SUPPLY.rationale: Material global oil/gas supply and price-moving events: Hormuz disruption, new sanctions, refinery attacks, Libya deal, Cuba blockade, BoC inflation signal.

FINANCIAL_STRESS.rationale: Systemic/credit-risk signals: Fed AI stability warning, credit-market bifurcation, Saudi liquidity tightness, bankruptcy, bond-market concentration, PBOC liquidity, gold-loan defaults.

HEALTH_POLICY.rationale: Verified drug-price/approval and coverage state changes with market relevance; excluded local commentary and single-firm promotions where non-material.

MILITARY_GEOPOLITICS.rationale: Verified strikes/attacks with material security and supply-chain transmission; UN/authoritative corroboration where available; excluded speculation and local crime.

MONETARY_INFLATION.rationale: Authoritative and corroborated inflation/policy state changes: Australian CPI high, Fed hawkish signals, BoC target, Fed minutes, Romania, India food, Singapore, US cooling.

POLITICAL_SOCIAL_SHOCK.rationale: High-impact verified shocks with cross-asset transmission: major earthquakes, shutdown deal/spending standoff, hurricane landfall, wildfire power cuts, disputed election, state of emergency.

PRECIOUS_METALS.rationale: Gold/silver price and demand state changes with verified moves: hawkish Fed selloff, central-bank buying, Singapore volumes, AI-bubble hedge narrative, rebound, Indian retail, mining approvals.

TECHNOLOGY_AI.rationale: Material AI/chip/supply-chain and policy state changes: Amazon deal, US chip-export probe/counter, semis selloff, TVA data center deal, data center moratoria, political backlash, Malaysia export-curb stance.

TRADE_CONTROLS.rationale: Verified tariff action and market transmission across equities, FX, gold; export-control allegation; supply reallocation and trade-deal friction.
